ordering_robustness.note: KPPS sign_stability is 1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION when max_abs_dev is at machine precision: it certifies that order-invariance was actually achieved, and is not a statistical robustness statement. The statistical robustness number is boot_sign_stability from the circular block bootstrap. The Cholesky arm is the artifact yardstick: it shows how much of a 'direction' the ordering alone could have manufactured (K628b / K865b).

full8.note: KPPS sign_stability is 1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION when max_abs_dev is at machine precision: it certifies that order-invariance was actually achieved, and is not a statistical robustness statement. The statistical robustness number is boot_sign_stability from the circular block bootstrap. The Cholesky arm is the artifact yardstick: it shows how much of a 'direction' the ordering alone could have manufactured (K628b / K865b).

lookahead_diagnostics.method: every OHLC bar strictly after the cut is replaced by an N(0, 0.005^2) random walk; features, forecasts and positions stamped on or before the cut must be bit-identical

H1.hypothesis: H1 — the three-basket system carries significant total spillover
H1.criterion: surrogate / block-bootstrap p < 0.05 vs an independent-AR no-spillover floor

H2.hypothesis: H2 — physical / credit volatility is a net transmitter INTO the AI leg
H2.criterion: KPPS pairwise NPDC > 0, Benjamini-Hochberg significant at q=0.10, AND block-bootstrap sign stability >= 90%; order-invariance of the estimator verified numerically; corroborated by the SPY-controlled HAC Granger arm
H2.granger_vs_npdc_tension: The identified Granger arm rejects no-lead in 7/8 forward pairs, so the physical/credit leg DOES carry in-sample lead information for AI volatility even after the SPY control. The net variance-share balance nevertheless runs the other way, and the sign is bootstrap-stable. The two measures answer different questions — incremental predictability of the conditional mean versus the balance of correlated-shock variance shares — and only the pre-specified net-directional criterion decides H2.
H2.note: The direction is judged ONLY on the order-invariant KPPS arm. The Cholesky sign-stability number is reported to size the artifact that sank K628b and K865b, not as evidence.

H2R_post_hoc.hypothesis: H2R (POST-HOC) — the AI leg is the net transmitter INTO the physical / credit leg, i.e. the funding-chain story runs backwards
H2R_post_hoc.criterion: complement of the pre-specified one-sided test: KPPS pairwise NPDC < 0, Benjamini-Hochberg significant at q=0.10 in its own family, bootstrap sign stability >= 90%, and the SPY-controlled Granger evidence at least as strong in the reverse direction as in the hypothesised one
H2R_post_hoc.caveat: KPPS shares are shares of CORRELATED shocks, so a net-directional number is a reduced-form informational lead, not a structural causal effect. Read together with the Granger arm, not instead of it.

H3.hypothesis: H3 — physical / credit volatility adds OOS predictive content beyond own volatility AND the broad-market volatility factor
H3.criterion: PRIMARY rung M3 vs M2: Clark-West one-sided p, Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 over the 12-cell family, with a positive OOS R² increment; and a bootstrap interval on the squared-error gap excluding zero for at least one cell
H3.why_the_ladder: Testing the exogenous block against a bare squared-return HAR-RV (the brief's literal reading, rung M0plusExog_vs_M0) is NOT identified: the exogenous regressors are range-based volatility, so part of any gain is estimator quality (rung M1_vs_M0) and part is the common market volatility factor (rung M2_vs_M1). Only M3_vs_M2 isolates the AI-infrastructure funding-chain channel, so only it governs this verdict.

H4.criterion: run only if H2 or H3 is ACCEPT/PARTIAL; beat buy-and-hold AND the own-volatility gate at 0 bp, otherwise turnover artifact
H4.reason: neither H2 nor H3 produced a surviving positive result

synthesis.one_line: Total spillover across the AI / power / credit system is large and real; the net variance-share direction runs from the AI leg OUTWARD, not inward; the physical/credit leg does carry FDR-surviving in-sample Granger lead information for AI volatility, and none of it converts into out-of-sample forecast value.
synthesis.what_this_rules_out: The tradable version of the J.P. Morgan AI-data-centre-financing thesis: that power/grid/credit volatility is an early-warning gauge you can put in front of a Nasdaq volatility forecast. In-sample lead information exists, but after own-volatility and broad-market-volatility controls it adds nothing out of sample, so the funding chain is not a usable volatility lead indicator at daily frequency with free data.
synthesis.what_would_change_it: Instrument the physical leg directly rather than through equity proxies: PJM/ERCOT interconnection-queue or capacity-auction prices, data-centre power-purchase-agreement spreads, and private-credit fund marks. Those are the variables the thesis is actually about; XLU/PAVE/HYG/LQD are the free shadows of them and the shadows carry the market factor along.

prior_art_guardrails.K628b: SPY net +43.7pp was a Cholesky-ordering artifact; KPPS gave +14.6pp
prior_art_guardrails.K865b: the DY direction was an ordering artifact while total spillover was real
prior_art_guardrails.K907: connectedness is not a VIX proxy (r = 0.001) — a separate risk dimension
prior_art_guardrails.K1508: the AI power-demand narrative did not reprice utility/grid volatility
prior_art_guardrails.K1332/K1343/K1344: public credit proxies: narrow or null as volatility signals
